apiEndpoints.note: Failures due to route mismatch, auth issues, and missing data

failures.fixCommit: N/A - legacy MVC project (not running server)
failures.symptom: 403 Forbidden — every admin-gated endpoint permanently returns 403
failures.rootCause: Legacy MVC project: JwtAuthorizeAttribute line 39 case-sensitive `allowed.Contains(userRole)`. Running v2 server uses ASP.NET Core `[Authorize]` which is case-insensitive.
failures.fix: Added StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase to allowed.Contains() call. NOTE: legacy MVC project, not the running v2 server.
failures.impact: All 19 admin-gated endpoints blocked. Admin console 100% non-functional.
failures.verification: Legacy MVC fix applied. Running v2 server uses ASP.NET Core which handles role case natively.

failures.fixCommit: Corrected swapped username/role parameter order in GenerateToken() call
failures.symptom: JWT Role claim set to username value instead of actual role — all admin endpoints return 403
failures.rootCause: v2 running server: GenerateToken(userId, email, user.Username, user.Role) — username and role parameters were SWAPPED. Role claim became 'admin' instead of 'Admin'.
failures.fix: Changed to: GenerateToken(userId, email, user.Role, user.Username)
failures.impact: All [Authorize(Roles='Admin')] endpoints returned 403. Admin console completely non-functional.

failures.fixCommit: Added seed block for Achievements table (8 rows)
failures.symptom: Page renders but shows empty data. API returns {success:true, data: []}
failures.rootCause: Database table Achievements has 0 rows. No seed data.
failures.fix: Added 8 achievement seed rows in SeedData.cs: Nutrition (50K children fed), Healthcare (1200 heart surgeries), Education (100 school libraries), Emergency (VND 25B flood relief), UNICEF Partner award, 10K volunteer hours, 3 care homes, VND 50B total raised.
failures.impact: Achievements page completely empty — about section broken
failures.verification: GET /api/v1/achievements/stats -> 200 OK; seed data present in SeedData.cs

failures.symptom: Page renders but shows empty data. API returns {success:true, data: []}
failures.rootCause: Database table team_members has 0 rows. EF snake_case naming convention handles table mapping.
failures.fix: Added explicit [Table('team_members')] (harmless redundancy). Added 8 seed team members: Executive Director, Programmes Director, CTO, Fundraising Head, Field Ops Manager, Communications Manager, Finance Director, HR Coordinator.
failures.verification: GET /api/v1/team -> 200 OK; seed data present in SeedData.cs

failures.fixCommit: Added seed block for Donations table (18 rows)
failures.symptom: Page renders but shows no donations. API returns empty array.
failures.rootCause: Database table Donations has 0 rows. No test donation data seeded.
failures.fix: Added 18 sample completed donation rows across admin and demo users with amounts from VND 100K to VND 5M.
failures.verification: Seed data present in SeedData.cs; GET /api/v1/donations/stats -> 200 OK

failures.symptom: EF queries CmsPages DbSet → maps to table 'CmsPages' (PascalCase) but actual DB table is 'cms_pages' (snake_case)
failures.rootCause: v2 DbContext uses SnakeCaseNamingConvention.ApplyToModel() which auto-converts ALL table names to snake_case. [Table] attribute is redundant but explicit.
failures.fix: Added [Table('cms_pages')]. Also applied same fix to legacy MVC project EntityModels.cs:540.
failures.impact: CMS admin editing potentially broken due to table name mismatch
failures.verification: EF naming convention handles mapping; explicit [Table] added for clarity

failures.symptom: EF queries TeamMembers DbSet → maps to table 'TeamMembers' but actual DB table is 'team_members'
failures.rootCause: Same as MAJ-005 — snake_case vs PascalCase mismatch; auto-fixed by SnakeCaseNamingConvention
failures.fix: Added [Table('team_members')]. Also applied same fix to legacy MVC project EntityModels.cs:795.
failures.verification: EF naming convention handles mapping; explicit [Table] added for clarity
